intro.text: Huge creatures with blue skin, red eyes and loose, sagging skin, said to know only two moods: boredom and rage. An army of them marches under Jastes Lekal.

Huge blue-skinned creatures with red eyes and loose skin, said to know only boredom and rage. The Lord Ruler built a weakness into them: a duralumin-boosted Allomantic Push lets a Mistborn take control of them.

A bestial race the Lord Ruler made with spikes to be his fiercely loyal army. Their spikes make them grow ever bigger and stronger while dulling their minds, and a powerful Mistborn, or a group of Soothers and Rioters, can control them.

description.text: Koloss are said to have just two moods, boredom and rage, so they spend their days milling about and fighting, each other if no one else is near. Their swords double as a check on numbers: a koloss without a big enough sword must kill another to get one. Most killing is on a whim, over a possession or a glance.
Koloss can live on almost anything, even dirt and ash, and the cold does not bother them.

Four spikes, each carrying another person's strength, push a koloss far past human limits and keep it growing until its heart gives out under its own size. Spikes can be reused, but they weaken each time, so koloss made from reused spikes keep more of their humanity, skills and speech.

The spikes dull a koloss's senses, including pain, yet it can still reason, remember, do some tasks and talk. When one dies, others nearby collect its spikes; after the Lord Ruler's death, koloss learned to make more of their own kind this way.
By Wax's day, some koloss-blooded have become Allomancers, well enough known in the Roughs to be recognised. "Kig" is a semi-offensive name for koloss-blooded.

items.text: On his way to Luthadel, Sazed ran into an army of koloss and was taken to their leader, Jastes Lekal.
Jastes recruited his koloss by paying them in fake wooden coins, which they carried in small sacks and would kill each other for.
Sazed told the crew that Jastes had twenty thousand koloss.
In Jastes's camp, Elend killed a small koloss and took its sword and its pouches of coins.
The koloss outside Luthadel broke into a huge brawl that stoked their rage until they attacked the city. Jastes had abandoned them after their carts of coins burned and they grew too wild to control.
Breeze could not Soothe the attacking koloss. Clubs said he had not lost a battle in twenty years, but before, he had always had koloss on his side.
Out of pewter, Vin used a duralumin-boosted Push on the nearby koloss and found she could control them.
Once the Lord Ruler's control was gone, many koloss attacked nearby people to make more of their kind. Both Vin and Ruin used koloss as the main force of their armies.
Koloss who died appeared in the Cognitive Realm just as the humans they had been before they were spiked.
